components.title: Durable lease-state store
components.capability: Transactional persistence for allocations, releases, scrub state, quarantine state, and tenant security epochs across process/node restarts.

components.title: Distributed compare-and-swap / fencing layer
components.capability: Monotonic ownership epochs or fencing tokens preventing two controllers from allocating the same physical accelerator after failover or partition.

components.title: HA controller ownership / leader election
components.capability: Explicit active-controller authority and failover behavior, integrated with fencing rather than best-effort locks.

components.title: Lease TTL, heartbeat, and orphan reconciliation
components.capability: Reclaim or quarantine resources after workload/controller death without prematurely releasing live workloads.

components.title: Idempotency and replay-protection store
components.capability: Request IDs and durable deduplication for allocate/release/scrub calls.

components.title: Real hardware inventory adapter
components.capability: Integration with GAP-02 and vendor APIs for device identity, memory, features, health, and hot-plug changes.

components.title: Partition topology/lifecycle adapter
components.capability: Representation of mutually compatible partition profiles and creation/destruction/drain operations for MIG/SR-IOV/vendor slices.

components.title: Vendor-specific scrub/reset executor
components.capability: Actual VRAM/HBM/state zeroization or reset with timeout, retry policy, health verification, and evidence.

components.title: Device attestation binding
components.capability: Cryptographic binding between discovered accelerator identity/capabilities, node identity, driver/firmware state, and GAP-06 attestation evidence.

components.title: Authenticated service boundary
components.capability: mTLS/workload identity or equivalent authentication for inventory, allocate, release, and scrub APIs.

components.title: Authorization/capability policy
components.capability: Tenant/workload permissions for device classes, partitions, administrative scrub, quarantine overrides, and sensitive inventory.

components.title: Versioned wire schemas
components.capability: Concrete JSON/Protobuf/WIT/RPC schema files for accelerator inventory, allocation, release, and scrub interfaces, including compatibility rules.

components.title: API transport/server
components.capability: Bounded request queues, deadlines, cancellation, backpressure, connection limits, and structured failure mapping.

components.title: Admission quotas and fairness
components.capability: Per-tenant/project caps, reservation classes, starvation prevention, queue discipline, and capacity ceilings.

components.title: Workload lifecycle integration
components.capability: Authoritative hooks for workload start, exit, crash, eviction, and restart so leases cannot leak or be released too early.

components.title: Split-brain and stale-controller tests
components.capability: Multi-controller fault tests proving fencing under delayed messages, network partitions, failover, and replay.

components.title: Multi-device topology scheduler
components.capability: NUMA/PCIe/NVLink/fabric locality, gang allocation, atomic multi-device reservation, and rollback.

components.title: Fragmentation-aware partition placement
components.capability: Profile compatibility and placement minimizing unusable residual accelerator capacity.

components.title: Power/thermal admission adapter
components.capability: Live constraint integration with GAP-10 so thermally unavailable devices cannot be leased.

components.title: Health/RAS integration
components.capability: ECC, Xid/device faults, link degradation, reset storms, predictive failure, and automatic quarantine/drain.

components.title: Hot-plug and inventory reconciliation loop
components.capability: Safely handle device disappearance, replacement, renumbering, and changed capabilities while leases exist.

components.title: Preemption/reservation policy
components.capability: Priority classes or reserved accelerators, including safe preemption semantics where enabled.

components.title: Constraint policy engine
components.capability: Precedence for security, residency, workload class, generation, feature, cost, power, and SLO constraints, with deterministic decision reasons.

components.title: Tamper-evident audit ledger
components.capability: Signed/chained events for allocation, release, scrub, quarantine, policy decisions, overrides, and controller leadership changes.

components.title: Metrics exporter
components.capability: Allocation latency, refusal reason, active leases, saturation, scrub latency/failure, queue depth, fragmentation, and reconciliation state.

components.title: Structured logs and trace propagation
components.capability: Stable operation/request/lease/device IDs, trace context, privacy controls, and correlation to release lineage.

components.title: Health/readiness/debug endpoints
components.capability: Version, configuration digest, dependency health, controller role, reconciliation lag, and safe explain output.

components.title: Dashboards and alerts
components.capability: Separate capacity exhaustion, policy rejection, scrub failure, device health failure, attack indicators, and software defects.

components.title: Declarative configuration schema
components.capability: Validation, secure defaults, site/environment overlays, provenance, atomic activation, and rollback.

components.title: Secrets/KMS integration
components.capability: Certificate/key retrieval, rotation, redaction, and fail-closed behavior when key or identity services are unavailable.

components.title: Usage accounting/export
components.capability: Durable device/partition occupancy records suitable for capacity analytics, chargeback/showback, and audit without trusting ephemeral process memory.

components.title: Operator quarantine/drain controls
components.capability: Explicit freeze, drain, unquarantine, force-reconcile, and maintenance workflows with authorization and audit.

components.title: Public schema fixtures and contract tests
components.capability: Golden requests/responses/error cases for every wire interface.

components.title: Adjacent-layer integration tests
components.capability: GAP-02, GAP-06, GAP-09, GAP-10, workload placement, runtime, and workload lifecycle integration tests.

components.title: Fuzzing/property tests
components.capability: Request parsing, schema handling, state-machine sequences, lease replay, and malformed inventory.

components.title: Broader concurrency tests
components.capability: Release-vs-scrub, allocate-vs-inventory-change, controller failover, multi-device transactions, and long-running race/soak tests.

components.title: Security adversarial suite
components.capability: Spoofed identity, capability escalation, stale lease replay, denial of service, side-channel assumptions, audit tampering, and malicious device metadata.

components.title: Fault-injection/disaster tests
components.capability: Store loss, partial write, process kill, node loss, network partition, time skew, dependency outage, and reconnect.

components.title: Performance/scale benchmarks
components.capability: p50/p95/p99/worst-case latency, burst/overload, fleet size, queue depth, memory/CPU overhead, and regression gates.

components.title: Compatibility matrix
components.capability: Supported Python/pk_core versions, API schema versions, architectures, drivers, firmware, hypervisors, accelerator families, and providers.

components.title: Packaging metadata and dependency pinning
components.capability: pyproject/build metadata, explicit pk_core compatibility range, reproducible wheel/sdist or repository packaging, and installation tests.

components.title: CI release gate
components.capability: Compile, unit, contract, integration, security, fuzz, benchmark, provenance, and artifact verification before release.

components.title: SBOM, signing, and provenance
components.capability: Signed release artifacts, dependency inventory, source/build attestations, and verification policy.

components.title: Threat model document
components.capability: Attacker classes, trust boundaries, residual-data threat analysis, stale-controller threats, side-channel assumptions, and mitigations.

components.title: Architecture Decision Record (ADR)
components.capability: Approved technology/state-store/API/fencing choices and explicit tradeoffs.

components.title: Named accountable owner and escalation path
components.capability: Owner, on-call/escalation route, incident severity policy, and support commitment.

components.title: Runbooks
components.capability: Bootstrap, rollout, rollback, emergency disable, store recovery, orphan reconciliation, failed scrub, device replacement, and incident containment.

components.title: Exception/waiver/deprecation register
components.capability: Owners, expiry dates, rationale, migration plan, and review cadence.

components.title: Source-series MASTER.md artifact
components.capability: Restore the authoritative master prompt/workflow source or remove all downstream assumptions that require it.

components.title: Formal production-exit evidence bundle
components.capability: Machine-readable acceptance results covering architecture, security, resilience, performance, observability, rollback, ownership, and all unresolved exceptions.
